review.summary: The round-3 finding is fixed and no new issues were found. The fix changes only ADR-014 and the TASK-061B spec: after reaping a child on every outcome, including a child that exited or crashed on its own, the supervisor sends SIGKILL to the process group addressed by the child PID while ignoring a missing group, and only then removes the per-child temporary directory while tolerating errors; TASK-061B adds a crashed-child test and acceptance criterion. The PID-reuse reasoning holds whenever a CmdStan process survives; the theoretical reuse window for an already empty group is negligible because Linux allocates PIDs cyclically and the container runs no other group-creating processes, so no change is needed. The deliberate-stop path gains only a harmless extra group signal and the five-second cancellation bound holds. ADR-012, ARCHITECTURE.md and FORECASTING.md remain consistent. There is no code, migration, schema, frontend or Compose change. TASK-061B and TASK-061C no longer require any architecture or statistical-method choice.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: ADR-014 and TASK-061B now send SIGKILL to the child's process group after reaping on every outcome, including self-exited and crashed children, ignore a missing group, then remove the temporary directory while tolerating errors, with a matching TASK-061B test and acceptance criterion.
